messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED — streaming.generate (eu-west-1) p99 elevated, SLO risk. Auto-alert: p95 = 420ms (SLO 200ms), p99 = 1.6s (SLO 1.0s). Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. link: https://monitoring.redwood/prod/streaming-eu-west-1

raj-oncall: ack here. I'm on it — starting triage. Any recent deploys to eu-west-1?

maria-sre: looking at metrics now. Cache miss ratio on prefix-cache jumped from 4% -> 45% ~ 08:42UTC. Streaming tail latencies line up. Could be prefix hash rotation landing.

den a-dev: we rolled prefix-hash v2 -> v3 in eu-west-1 at 08:40 by canary rollout (deploy-5512). I flagged it in release notes but didn't expect client-side cache invalidation to spike that hard.

deploy-bot: deploy 5512 -> canary started at 2026-03-15T08:39:12Z by @dena-dev. status: partial (25% traffic).

raj-oncall: ok timeline matches. hypothesis: rollout changed prefix hash mapping -> high prefix misses -> more paging -> streaming stalls -> p99 spike.

helen-support: we already have two customer escalations in EU region. Customers report streaming stalls and partial responses, not complete failures. Support ticket IDs: CS-9218, CS-9220. Will escalate to account managers.

maria-sre: quick queries:
```
# cache metrics
SELECT time, prefix_miss_rate, backend_latency_ms FROM cache_metrics WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND time > '2026-03-15T08:30:00Z'
```
Result: miss_rate jumps at 08:40 -> backend latency from 80ms -> 700ms median for paged reads.

raj-oncall: mitigation proposals:
- rollback prefix-hash rollout to v2 for eu-west-1
- enable prefetch-fallback path (bypass new prefix routing) for streaming routes
- increase dedicated pool size by 10% for 15m to absorb paging
- flip on devex temporary config: `streaming.slo-relax=true` to avoid alerts noise
Which to execute now?

den a-dev: rollback option available. I can push a rollback of rollout 5512 to scale back canary to 0% in eu-west-1. It will revert mapping to v2. Expect ~2m for rollout to converge.

raj-oncall: do it. Deploy-bot, initiate rollback. I'll also enable the fallback path.

ops-bot: executing runbook step: `rollback_to_release --region eu-west-1 --release 5509`
ops-bot: rollback step 1 started. draining canary nodes. (this will not restart customers)

deploy-bot: rollback triggered for deploy 5512 by @dena-dev at 2026-03-15T08:44:10Z.

maria-sre: enabling prefetch fallback: patching routing config for /v1/stream to use `prefix_cache_fallback: true` and reduce batching window to 10ms. Applying now.

raj-oncall: bumping dedicated pool: `redwood infra scale --pool streaming-eu-west1 --delta 10% --duration 15m`

ops-bot: pool scale command accepted. extra nodes provisioning (expected ready ~08:47).

helen-support: note for customer comms: impact mostly degraded latency and partial stalls for long streams (>8k tokens). Short requests seem mostly OK. No data leak, no errors 5xx so far.

maria-sre: logs snippet from cache gateway at 08:41:22: 
```
[2026-03-15T08:41:22Z] WARN prefix-mapper: unexpected-prefix-hash UUID mismatch (incoming=0x7f4a2c, expected=0x1a4b3d) key=kb:chat:client:12345
[trace] cache.get -> MISS -> fetch page -> backend_rpc 512ms
```
Miss correlation looks tight with client namespace rotations.

raj-oncall: rollback completed? status?

deploy-bot: rollback finished at 2026-03-15T08:46:05Z. canary traffic now 0%.

maria-sre: early signals: prefix-miss rate dropping, p95 in eu-west-1 down to ~190ms, p99 down to ~980ms (still borderline). backend RPC latency also falling.

helen-support: CS-9218 updated: we told customer we are mitigating and expect 10-15m. They asked for postmortem.

raj-oncall: good. leaving temporary mitigations in place: `prefix_cache_fallback:true` and scaled pool for another 10m. I'll hand off to li-oncall for continued monitoring and postmortem.

li-oncall: ack takeover. Summary for next shift: root cause likely prefix-hash rollout (deploy 5512) created namespace mapping incompat for a subset of keys -> big spike in cache misses -> paging thrash -> streaming tail p99 increase. Mitigations taken: rollback to v2, enable fallback routing, scale pool. Next actions: run full keyspace parity check, re-run canary with traffic shadowing+compat flag, prepare postmortem draft, contact affected customers with timeline.

raj-oncall: adding runbook pointer and playbook notes: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/prefix-hash-rotation. Please include exact query outputs in postmortem.

maria-sre: capturing metric exports and console dashboards for incident. Will attach graphs (p95/p99, prefix_miss, backend_latency, paging_retries) to the incident.

helen-support: I'll coordinate customer comms and gather impacted request IDs for CS team.

li-oncall: final handoff note: last observed p99 = 0.95s at 08:58UTC and trending down. Will keep mitigations for 30m and then stage a controlled canary with `compat=on` flag. If stable for 2h, safe to resume rollout.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: mitigated -> monitoring. incident severity downgraded to SEV-2.

raj-oncall: thanks everyone. tagging @dena-dev for follow-up on rollout gating (add migration/compat checks).

dena-dev: will update the rollout docs and add a safety check to fail canary if prefix-miss > 10% for 5m.

li-oncall: taking this to postmortem channel. closing this thread after 1h if stable.

ops-bot: NOTE: automated ticket created: PM-INC-2876512345 for postmortem and RCA.
